method.accuracy: Pooled completed passes / attempted passes; per-match median also provided.
method.possession: Pooled reported possession including uninterrupted intended pass flight. Identical accounting before/after.
method.conditions: Same real-club XIs, tactical settings, seeds, duration and kickoff orientation before/after. AI coaching disabled. Validation repeats the S–B and possession-B fixtures with seed +17291, chosen after freezing the candidate.
method.selection: Several development variants were assessed on the 24 main cases. The conservative version was chosen before additional mirror and fresh-seed validation. Validation has not been used to tune further.
limitations: Fixed clubs and few seeds; not a population estimate or score guarantee.
S–B separation remains short of the requested 90% versus 65–70% band. Player attributes, not club tier, determine execution.
Possession-style B can still retain more possession than the stronger side.
Equal-S controls cover one mirrored XI, not every strong club.

changes: Ball-side screens stay on diagonal passing lanes.
